tool_schemas.name: getCardsByList
tool_schemas.description: Lists cards in the specified list, optionally filtered by status and sorted, returning up to `limit` results and a `cursor` for the next page when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `list_id` is not a valid `trl_lst_...` ID, `limit` is outside 1–200, `cursor` is malformed, or `sort/status` are not supported. Raises NOT_FOUND if the list does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the list’s board.

list_id.description: ID of the list whose cards should be returned.

limit.description: Maximum number of cards to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getLists
tool_schemas.description: Lists lists on the specified board (or the configured board when `board_id` is omitted), optionally filtered by status and sorted, returning up to `limit` results and a `cursor` for pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `board_id` is not a valid `trl_brd_...` ID, `limit` is outside 1–200, `cursor` is malformed, or `sort/status` are not supported. Raises NOT_FOUND if the board does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the board.

board_id.description: ID of the board to fetch lists from (defaults to configured board if omitted).

limit.description: Maximum number of lists to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getRecentActivity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the append-only activity log for the specified board (or the configured board when `board_id` is omitted), optionally filtered by event type, actor, list, and/or card, and sorted by created time with cursor-based pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any provided IDs don’t match their expected `trl_*` patterns, `event_type` contains unsupported values, `limit` is outside 1–200, `cursor` is malformed, or `sort` is not supported. Raises NOT_FOUND if the referenced board does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the board.

board_id.description: ID of the board to fetch activity for (defaults to configured board if omitted).

event_type.description: Filter activity events by one or more event types.

actor_member_id.description: Filter activity to events performed by the given member.

list_id.description: Filter activity to events associated with the given list.

card_id.description: Filter activity to events associated with the given card.

limit.description: Maximum number of activity events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

sort.description: Sort order for returned activity events.

tool_schemas.name: addCard
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new card in the given list and returns the created card, using the provided title/description/due date and optional floating-point `position` within the list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `list_id` is invalid, `title` is empty, `due_at` is not a valid ISO-8601 datetime, or `position` is not a number. Raises NOT_FOUND if the destination list does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the list’s board.

list_id.description: ID of the list to add the new card to.

position.description: Floating-point position of the card within the list.

tool_schemas.name: updateCard
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing card’s fields (title, description, position, due date, and/or status) and returns the updated card; `due_at` may be set to null to clear it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `card_id` is invalid, `title` is provided but empty, `due_at` is not a valid ISO-8601 datetime (or null), `position` is not a number, or `status` is not one of the supported values. Raises NOT_FOUND if the card does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the card’s board.

card_id.description: ID of the card to update.

position.description: New floating-point position of the card within its list.

due_at.description: New due date/time for the card (ISO 8601); set to null to clear.

tool_schemas.name: moveCard
tool_schemas.description: Moves a card to the destination list and returns the updated card, optionally setting its floating-point `position` within the destination list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `card_id`/`list_id` are invalid or `position` is not a number. Raises NOT_FOUND if the card or destination list does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the card and destination list (including when they are on boards you can’t access).

card_id.description: ID of the card to move.

position.description: New floating-point position of the card within the destination list.

tool_schemas.name: changeCardMembers
tool_schemas.description: Replaces the card’s member assignments with the provided full set of `member_ids` and returns the updated card membership state. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `card_id` is invalid, any member ID is invalid, or `member_ids` is not an array. Raises NOT_FOUND if the card does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the card’s board or are not permitted to assign members on it.

card_id.description: ID of the card whose members should be changed.

member_ids.description: Full replacement set of member IDs that should be assigned to the card.

tool_schemas.name: archiveCard
tool_schemas.description: Archives the specified card (sets its status to `archived`) and returns the updated card. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `card_id` is not a valid `trl_crd_...` ID. Raises NOT_FOUND if the card does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the card’s board.

card_id.description: ID of the card to archive.

tool_schemas.name: addList
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new list on the given board and returns the created list, using the provided name and optional floating-point `position` within the board. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `board_id` is invalid, `name` is empty, or `position` is not a number. Raises NOT_FOUND if the board does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the board.

board_id.description: ID of the board to add the list to.

position.description: Optional position value for ordering the list within the board.

tool_schemas.name: archiveList
tool_schemas.description: Archives the specified list (sets its status to `archived`) and returns the updated list. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `list_id` is not a valid `trl_lst_...` ID. Raises NOT_FOUND if the list does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the list’s board.

list_id.description: ID of the list to archive.

tool_schemas.name: getMyCards
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paged list of cards assigned to the authenticated user, optionally filtered by board_id, status, due_at (before/after), and updated_after, sorted by the requested field and order; the response includes up to limit cards and a next cursor when more results are available (omit cursor to fetch the first page). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if any filter or sort parameter is invalid (including malformed IDs, invalid date-time values, or limit outside 1–100). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the user is not authenticated, FORBIDDEN if the user is not permitted to view the specified board’s cards, and NOT_FOUND if board_id is provided but does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

board_id.description: If provided, only return cards from this board.

due_before.description: If provided, only return cards with due_at before this timestamp.

due_after.description: If provided, only return cards with due_at after this timestamp.

updated_after.description: If provided, only return cards updated after this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of cards to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: getCard
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single card by ID from the configured board and returns it. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `card_id` is not a valid `trl_crd_...` ID. Raises NOT_FOUND if the card does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the card’s board.

card_id.description: ID of the card to fetch.

metadata.name: Trello
metadata.description: This backend stores Trello-like boards with lists and cards, plus card membership assignments and an append-only activity log to power recent activity feeds. Core workflows are: read lists/cards from the configured board, create/update/move/archive cards and lists, manage card members, and query car
